_description: Chathead replacements by hairstyle: identity kit id (a head kit) -> a model file under data/models, shown in dialogue in place of that kit's chathead for every player with the hairstyle. Female head kits are 45-55, 118-128, 141-143, 152 and 154-200; their originals are in data/models/player-chathead/female/<kit>/chathead.dat.
